## At Pune's Anantrao Pawar College of Engineering & Research
**Category:** Institutional History | **Type:** HTML | **Source:** [https://abmspcoerpune.org/a-b-m-s-parishad-history/](https://abmspcoerpune.org/a-b-m-s-parishad-history/)

### About A.B.M.S.Parishad
Akhil Bharatiya Maratha Shikshan Parishad (A.B.M.S Parishad), an educational trust was founded by a team of renowned educationists and social reformers. It was established in 1907 with the thought “Bahujan Hitay, Bahujan Sukhaya”. In the first half of the 20th century A.B.M.S. Parishad made a commendable contribution of awakening and inspiring the masses who were deprived of education for generations. Owing to its inspiration, large number of educational institution were established throughout Maharashtra and outside Maharashtra. A.B.M.S Parishad draws its inspiration from Mahatma Phule, Rajashri Shahu Maharaj, the Ruler of Kolhapur and Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar who fought for economic, social and political justice and advocated empowerment of economically and socially disadvantaged section of the society.

### College Location
The institute is located in the heart of the city at a distance of-
- 20 km from Lohagaon Airport,
- 15 Km from Pune Railway Station,
- 2 Km from Swargate Bus Stand,
- 8 Km from Shivajinagar Railway Station & Bus Stand,
- 4 Km from Deccan Gymkhana,
- 189 Km from Mumbai.

### 189 Km from Mumbai.
The institute is situated in the area of 10 acres of land surrounded by beautiful landscape of Sahyadri Hills of Western Ghats nearing to famous Parvati Hills. Site is surrounded by lush of green and scenic beauty, fresh air, free from pollution and abandoned water supply. This site is an attractive place for visitors when beautification of campus completed.
The Pune city is known as “Oxford of East” is knowledge capital of our country. The city is blessed with rich, cultural and academic heritage. The city is covering, Engineering, Automobile, Pharmacy besides premier I.T. establishments. The premier industries consist of Tata Motors, Bajaj Auto, Force & Bharat Forge and I.T. Industries namely Infosys, T.C.S., Cognizant, Wipro and many more.  In addition to theses, numerous small scale industries, opening wide area of employment opportunities to the local people. Besides more and more multinational industrial offices are being set up throughout industrial belt of Pune.
We at A.B.M.S.P. are committed to bridge the gap between the institute and industrial visits, training programmes, projects and campus placements.

## Apcoer college pune - Anantrao Pawar college
**Category:** Institutional History | **Type:** HTML | **Source:** [https://abmspcoerpune.org/a-b-m-s-parishad-history/about-institute/](https://abmspcoerpune.org/a-b-m-s-parishad-history/about-institute/)

### About Institute
Anantrao Pawar College of Engineering and Research is situated in nation’s education hub, Pune and recognized for its quality education and research. It is the institute of Akhil Bhartiya Maratha Shikshan Parishad, Parvati Pune 09, an educational trust was founded by a team of renowned educationists and social reformers. The institute is situated in the area of 10 acres of land surrounded by beautiful landscape of Sahyadri Hills of Western Ghat nearing to famous Parvati Hills. The institute is established in 2012 having 5 UG and 2 PG courses affiliated to SPPU, Pune. Institute is on creating versatile engineers who can apply their knowledge and skills in any field across the globe. Highly qualified faculty members, well equipped laboratories, extensive industry – academia interactions all serve to make engineering education at APCOER campus a unique and enriching experience.

### Our Vision
Committed to comprehensive development of students through quality technical education.

### Our Mission
1) To Provide state of art infrastructure that shall create ambience to encourage novel ideas, research activities and consultancy services. 2) To inspire students in creation & entrepreneurship. 3) To create future technocrats with intelligence, technical skills & good ethical moral values so as to serve needs of society & industries. 4) To provide healthy Teaching-Learning environment that will cultivate contemporary research activities, innovations & inventions. 5) To develop center of excellence in technical education.

### About APCOER-TBI
- Host Entity
Akhil Bharatiya Maratha Shikshan Parishad’s Anantrao Pawar College of Engineering & Research, Parvati, Pune 411009 started in 2012 having 6 UG, 2 PG, 4 B.Voc. courses and Ph.D Research Centre affiliated to Savitribai Phule Pune University, Pune. APCOER Technology Business Incubation Centre is develop for developing young entrepreneurs/students/faculties innovative Ideas to successful startups. The institute and Incubation Centre are started by Akhil Bhartiya Maratha Shikshan Parishad, Parvati, Pune 09, an educational trust was founded by a team of renowned educationists and social reformers. The Institute and APCOER TBI are situated in the area of 10 acres of land surrounded by beautiful landscape of Sahyadri Hills of Western Ghat nearing to famous Parvati Hills. Institute is committed to impart quality technical education as per the needs and expectations of all the stakeholders. APCOER, Pune is under the Mentorship of College of Engineering, Pune (COEP). National & International recognized Researchers are involved in the Innovation Club of Institute guiding the faculties and students for Product development, Startups and to become Entrepreneur through Business Incubation Centre. APCOER, Pune is committed to comprehensive development of Students through quality technical education. Institute is nurturing & cultivating innovative ideas/ projects/ patents/ copyrights of students and faculties for developing their own startups through APCOER Technology Business Incubation Centre. The experts from various fields are guiding and sponsoring to built startup Ecosystem. APCOER Innovation Club members are identifying current & future needs of society/ industry and students/ faculties solving it by technical and innovative way to develop to own startups.
- Justification for the selected thrust area:
ABMSP’s APCOER TBI decided to work on “Precision and Smart Agro Engineering Instruments and Equipments”, as already many researchers are working sustainable solution in the field of Agriculture Technology. Currently large number of agri-machinery products are being imported and sold in Indian market. Farmers are still working with traditional methods and instrument which are inefficient and require more efforts. With advancement in technology in the field of artificial intelligence, machine learning, IOT, robotics and data science, there is a wide scope to support the farmers and local industries MSMEs to boost the local economy. Rapidly expanding mechanization of agriculture is creating large scope for new businesses to develop agri machinery and IOT based solutions to farmers. In providing these solutions students, entrepreneurs, start-ups and MSMEs can play a vital role. However, it is required to bring all these stakeholders together to form an innovation ecosystem. Technology business incubator can connect all these stakeholders and helps in boosting the local economy. The proposed incubator would focus on promoting start-ups in this business space and provide support for innovation to meet typical Indian agriculture needs. The institute is surrounded by many industrial clusters MSMEs, viz, Parvati Industrial estate, Katraj MIDC, Dhayari MIDC in the periphery of 15 Km. These MSMEs are contributing in providing local employment which helps to grow the local economy. However, they are facing lot of problems related to innovation ecosystem, facilities, mentoring, skilled manpower, technology transfer services etc. The institute has the potential to address to all these issues and its biggest strength is innovative students, industry connect and faculties. The proposed Technology business incubator can act as an economic development tool to promote growth through innovation, and application of technology. The Institute has very good connect with farmers to understand their problems. Institute is already working on a Agronet project, which aims at giving distance education to farmers. Through collaboration with Sakal Papers, institute is connected with 4 lakh farmers and providing them the solutions using AI-NLP technology through a mobile app. The students and faculties are currently working on many agricultural projects like strawberry crop monitoring, crop disease detection, IOT base project related to measurement of parameters of weather, soil, nutrients, seeds etc. Institute has also developed a drone for remote operated insecticide spray and a polyhouse structure in college premises. Institute has developed a mechanized IOT based greenhouse structure and a Gantry robot on the campus. Focus of the incubator is “Engineering for Agriculture” To develop instruments, equipment for agriculture with the help of local industry to boost the local economy focusing on improving the living standard of framers and supporting the MSMEs to grow their business.

### Head of Department, Artificial Intelligence & Data Science (AI & DS),
Profile :- Click Here
The Department of Artificial Intelligence & Data Science (AI & DS), established in 2020 , has rapidly emerged as a hub of academic excellence and innovation. Our greatest strength lies in our highly motivated, multidisciplinary faculty—bringing together expertise in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Data Analytics, AI engineering, and allied fields. Supported by dedicated technical and administrative staff, we provide students with a strong foundation to operate in a global, multicultural, rapidly evolving technological environment.
Our graduates have gone on to work with leading national and international corporations—joining firms at the cutting edge of AI, Data Science, Consulting, R&D, and analytics. Many have also taken up roles in startups and research labs, contributing meaningfully to solutions that impact society.
It is our hope that we will continue to deliver the highest standards in teaching, research, and ethical practice, thus serving society and humanity at large. We expect our students not only to absorb knowledge and skills during their stay with us, but to carry forward these values and contribute positively wherever they go.
It gives me great pleasure to welcome you to the Department of Artificial Intelligence and Data Science (AI & DS). The department is one of the fastest-growing disciplines, with a vision to create professionals who can address complex real-world challenges through innovation, research, and technology.
We, at the Department of AI & DS, are committed to creating a vibrant ecosystem where students evolve as innovators, leaders, and lifelong learners. I welcome all aspiring learners to be part of this journey and contribute to shaping a smarter, sustainable, and technology-driven future.

### About Us
Our Institute has started a new course B.E in -Artificial Intelligence and Data Science in the Academic year 2020-2021.
Highlights of The Department:
Artificial Intelligence and Data Science is one of the emerging areas out of 10 special categories identified by AICTE and MHRD which can meet the upcoming requirements of the Industrial Revolution. Artificial Intelligence is a major step forward in how computer system adapts, evolves and learns. It has widespread application in almost every industry and is considered to be a big technological shift, similar in scale to past events such as the industrial revolution, the computer age, and the smart phone revolution.
The course covers the core principles of Data Science, the process of ethically acquiring,  engineering, analyzing, visualizing and ultimately monetizing data. It equips it with the basic tools and techniques of data handling, exploratory data analysis, data visualization and data-based inference.
Aims to train students in the rapidly growing field of Artificial Intelligence & Data Science, to be vibrant Research Hub in this area 1. Includes Advanced Laboratory Facilities, Industry Institute Research Collaborations. 2. Impart knowledge sharing by Domain Experts, Value Added Courses, Collaborative Learning with Reputed Universities in India and Abroad.
Salient Features of the Course
Artificial Intelligence (AI) deals with the intelligence demonstrated by machines to design solutions to problems by observing the environmental changes. ii. Data Science (DS) deals with the analysis of huge volume of data to reveal hidden patterns and correlations to get new insights. iii. One among the most demanding, highest paid job and future scope of IT & Telecom industry. iv. Applications like Alexa/Siri, Erica/Sophia, Teslaâ€™s driverless car, Chatbot etc are becoming common. v. AI powered Robots can take over human life endangering jobs like firefighting, deep sea oil drilling, mining works with high mortality rate etc.
This course is for the students who want toâ€¦
– Acquire the ability to design intelligent solutions to problems in a variety of domains – Create cutting edge AI Applications – Have a career with exceptional prospective fields and challenging roles in a futuristic industry
* Career path after the course:
Some of the leading roles that can be chosen for career are: – Machine Learning Engineer – Technology Officer – Data Scientist – Business Analyst – Artificial Intelligence Engineer – Software Engineer – Data Analyst – Network Administrator – Machine Learning Architect – Webmaster & Technocrat – Database Administrator
Strengths of the Department
- Aims to train students in the rapidly growing field of Artificial Intelligence & Data Science, to be vibrant Research Hub in this area Includes Advanced Laboratory Facilities, Industry Institute Research Collaborations.
- Impart knowledge sharing by Domain Experts, Value Added Courses, Collaborative Learning with Reputed Universities in India and Abroad.
- Highly qualified and experienced faculty with expertise in AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, IoT, Cybersecurity, and Data Analytics.
- State-of-the-art laboratories and computing facilities for hands-on learning and research.
- Industry collaborations, internships, and certification programs to bridge the gap between academia and industry.
- Strong focus on research, innovation, and entrepreneurship through projects, hackathons, and publications.
- Holistic student development through technical, professional, and co-curricular activities.
- Strengthen industry tie-ups for internships, projects, and placements specifically in AI & DS domains such as Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, Big Data, and Predictive Analytics.
- Introduce certification programs and workshops led by industry experts to augment academic curriculum (e.g. in cloud services, AI toolkits, ethical AI).
- Increase student participation in competitions, hackathons, R&D projects, and publications.
- Upgrade laboratory infrastructure and computational resources (GPUs, cloud credits) to support hands-on learning and experimentation.
- To establish the department as a Centre of Excellence in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science.
- To promote interdisciplinary research leading to patents, publications, and innovative solutions for society.
- To develop strong global collaborations with universities and research organizations.
- To contribute to national missions in AI, Digital India, and Industry 4.0 through student and faculty research.
- To nurture graduates who are not only technically proficient but also ethically responsible and socially committed.
- Data Scientist / Data Analyst – analyzing and interpreting complex data to aid decision-making.
- Machine Learning Engineer – designing, training, and deploying ML models for real-world applications.
- AI Engineer – developing AI systems for speech, vision, robotics, healthcare, and automation.
- Business Intelligence (BI) Developer – transforming data into actionable insights for organizations.
- Big Data Engineer – handling large-scale data processing, storage, and retrieval systems.
- Natural Language Processing (NLP) Specialist – working with speech recognition, chatbots, and text analytics.
- Computer Vision Engineer – developing vision-based applications for security, healthcare, AR/VR, and autonomous systems.
- Cloud & DevOps Engineer – implementing AI and DS solutions using cloud platforms and scalable infrastructures.
- AI Product Manager / Consultant – bridging technology and business to deliver AI-driven products and solutions.
- Researcher / Innovator – contributing to R&D, patents, and academic advancements in AI & DS.
Higher Education & Research
Students can also pursue postgraduate studies (M.Tech/MS/PhD) in AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, or allied areas at reputed national and international universities, opening pathways for teaching, advanced research, and entrepreneurship .
Industry Domains Hiring AI & DS Graduates
- IT Services & Consulting
- Finance & Banking (FinTech)
- Healthcare & Bioinformatics
- E-Commerce & Retail
- Manufacturing & Industry 4.0
- Smart Cities, IoT & Automation
- Cybersecurity & Defense
- Entertainment, Media & Gaming

Graduates can work as Data Scientists, AI Engineers, ML Engineers, Analysts, and Research Professionals.
Students primarily learn Python, R, SQL, Java, and C++.
The curriculum includes TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Hadoop, Spark, and cloud platforms.

### Institute Vision & Mission
Vision: Committed to comprehensive development of students through quality technical education
1) To  Provide state of art infrastructure that shall create ambience to encourage novel ideas, research activities and consultancy services.
2) To inspire students in creation & entrepreneurship.
3) To create future technocrats with intelligence, technical skills,& good ethical moral values so as to serve needs of society & industries.
4) To provide a healthy Teaching-Learning environment that will cultivate contemporary research activities, innovations & inventions.
5) To develop center of excellence in technical education.

### Department Vision & Mission
To develop globally competent Artificial Intelligence and Data Science Professionals through quality technical education
- To develop Data Science professionals with ethical and social values.
- To deliver the knowledge in the field of Artificial Intelligence for solving real world     problem.
- To encourage research and innovation.
- To prepare students for current industry practices, teamwork and                           entrepreneurship.

### About Us
Alumni networks can be a great way to stay connected with institute after graduation. They are valuable resources for networking, job opportunities, and career advice. An alumni network is a great resource if students are looking for a job. Many alums are willing to help recent graduates with their job search, and they can provide advice and contacts to help you get your foot in the door. Your network is your net worth. Porter Gale With this mindful thought Anantrao Pawar College of Engineering and Research has established an ALUMNI ASSOCIATION OF APCOER With Registration Number: Maharashtra/1146/2018/Pune Date: 21/08/2018 ALUMNI ASSOCIATION OF APCOER believes that associations will provide valuable resources and networking opportunities which can help alumni to stay connected with their industry and connect with other alumni.

### Main objectives to establish alumni association are as follows -
1) To Mentor the students of the college for higher education, development of professional ethics and social awareness
2) To encourage the students of the college & members of the Association for research & development work in various fields of Engineering
3) To arrange and support in placement activities for the students
4) Promote the industry-institute interaction to bridge the gap between industry requirements and education offered and enhance students’ employability
5) To encourage and guide the students of the college on self employment to become entrepreneurs.
6) To provide Scholarships to deserving students and ex-students of the college – for the purpose of Education and Sport.
7) To encourage and support students of the college in sports, cultural and extra-curricular activities.
8) Facilitate and encourage alumni to contribute towards improvement of infrastructure for all round development of the current students of Anantrao Pawar College of Engineering & Research.

‘Institution’s Innovation Council (IICs) of APCOER Total Member-54 (Faculty-17, Students-37) Ministry of Education (MoE), Govt. of India has established ‘MoE’s Innovation Cell (MIC)’ to systematically foster the culture of Innovation among all Higher Education Institutions (HEIs). The primary mandate of MIC is to encourage, inspire and nurture young students by supporting them to work with new ideas and transform them into prototypes while they are informative years.
MIC has envisioned encouraging creation of ‘Institution’s Innovation Council (IICs) across selected HEIs. A network of IICs are established to promote innovation and entrepreneurship in the Institution through multitudinous modes leading to an innovation promotion ecosystem in the campuses. MIC has established Institution’s Innovation Council in more than 2700 Instiutions till December 2021.

### Major Focus
• To create a vibrant local innovation ecosystem. • Start-up supporting mechanism in HEIs. • Prepare institute for Atal Ranking of institutions on innovation achievements framework. • Establish function ecosystem for scouting ideas and pre-incubation of ideas. • Develop better cognitive ability among students.

### Function of IIC
• To conduct various Innovation, IPR and entrepreneurship-related activities prescribed by MIC in time bound fashion. • Identify and reward innovations and share success stories. • Organize periodic workshops/ seminars/ interactions with entrepreneurs, investors, professionals and create a mentor pool for student innovators. • Network with peers and national entrepreneurship development organizations. • Create an Institution’s Innovation portal to highlight innovative projects carried out by institution’s faculty and students. • Organize Hackathons, idea competition, mini-challenges etc. with the involvement of industries.

Dr. RAVIRAJ RAMESH SORATE APCOER TBI Co-ordinator raviraj.sorate@abmspcoerpune.org

### Introductin to APCOER-TBI
ABMSP’s Anantrao Pawar College of Engineering & Research, Pune started Technology Business Incubator(TBI) Center to inculcate entrepreneurship and creation of enterprises on knowledge based innovation specially focused to Technology and Information & communication technology.
A technology business incubator is an organizational setup that nurtures technology based and knowledge driven companies by helping them survive during the startup period. Incubators do this by providing an integrated package of work space, shared office services, access to specialized equipment along with value added services like fund raising, business planning, technical assistance and networking support. The main objective of the technology business incubators is to produce successful business ventures that create jobs and wealth in the region, along with encouraging an attitude of innovation in the country as a whole. The primary aspects that this report shall go into are the stages of a startup, the motivational factors behind establishing incubators by governments & private players, the process followed by them in selecting, nurturing talent as well as providing post incubation support. Incubators play in the general economy apart from their function of incubating companies, such as educational or public research roles.
Incubation is a business support process that accelerates the successful development of startup and fledgling companies, also referred to as â€˜clientsâ€™ [of the incubator], by providing entrepreneurs in the company with an array of targeted resources and services. These services are usually developed or orchestrated by the incubator management and offered both in the business incubator and through its network of contacts, in the form of mentorship and financing An incubatorâ€™s main goal is to produce successful firms that will leave the program financially viable and freestanding. These incubator graduates have the potential to create jobs, revitalize neighbourhoods, commercialize new technologies, and strengthen local and national economies. As a part of their services, incubators usually also provide clients access to appropriate rental space and flexible leases, shared basic business services and equipment, technology support services and assistance in obtaining the financing necessary for company growth along with mentors to guide the company through its initial steps. Incubators also play an active role in the economy of the region by serving as a focal point of interaction between venture capitalists, academicians, university students and government members. This potent collection of stakeholders allows for an intensive exchange of ideas and enables the creation of quick as well as efficient solutions to problems that plague young businesses in a country. The benefits of this extend not only to the stakeholders mentioned above but also to the general economy of the region as well.

ADMISSION PROCEDURE & ELIGIBILITY :
The admission in general will be as per the rules and regulations laid by Directorate of Technical Education, Maharashtra State, Mumbai. The eligibility will be according to the norms of DTE & University of Pune.
Admission Process for CAP :
The students can apply on line for the First Shift Courses as per the DTE notification. The choice code has been given in the Brochure of DTE Mumbai. Details of centralized admission procedure are available on the DTE website Click Here…! The Student has to apply on line as per the directives of Director Technical Education.
The Candidate should be Passed HSC or its equivalent examination with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects along with one of the Chemistry or Biotechnology or Biology or Technical or Vocational subjects, and obtained at least 50% marks (at least 45% marks, in case of Backward class categories and Persons with Disability candidates belonging to Maharashtra State only) in the above subjects taken together; and obtained score in CET conducted by the Competent Authority.
The Candidate should be  Passed Diploma in Engineering and Technology and obtained at least 50% marks (at least 45% marks, in case of Backward class categories and Persons with Disability candidates belonging to Maharashtra State only)
The Candidate should be Passed B.Sc. Degree from a Recognized University as defined by UGC and obtained at least 50% marks (at least 45% marks, in case of backward class categories and Persons with Disability candidates belonging to Maharashtra State only) and passed XII standard with Mathematics as a subject.
Fees Structure for (First Year – Under Graduate) Click Here…!
Fees Structure (First Year – Post Graduate)
Fees Structure (First Year – B.Voc) All the rules about fees declared by the Government of Maharashtra – Fees Regulating Authority from time to time will be applicable to all the Students. For Reserved category Students Government rules will be followed and subject to the submission of required documents.
First Year Admission Process for Institute Level/Vacant Seat :
The candidates interested in securing admission under institute level/vacant seats, in the college should apply prescribed application form as per schedule notified by the college authorities from time to time and admission will be done strictly in accordance with rules prescribed by Directorate of Technical Education, Maharashtra State, Mumbai including eligibility criteria. In this regards please refer DTE website www.dte.org.in for eligibility and rules of college website.
The advertisement for admission against vacant seats will be published in different news-papers and also on our website – www.abmspcoerpune.org
The tuition fees for each academic year will be levied as per sanctioned by Shikshan Shulka Samiti appointed by Govt. of Maharashtra, Mumbai.
Refund of fees on cancellation of first year admission will be in accordance with rules notified by Directorate of Technical Education, Maharashtra State, Mumbai.

### Overview of Bachelor of Vocational
About B. Voc. Program: B. Voc. programs offer undergraduate courses in Software Development, Automobile Servicing, Refrigeration and Air Conditioning and Electronics Manufacturing Services, affiliated to University Grant Commission (UGC), All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), and Government of Maharashtra. This course has been started in the academic year 2019-20. The department of B. Voc. Program is committed to provide a value added quality education to under graduate students through its B. Voc.

Programme Name | Seats
B. Voc. In Software Development | 60
B. Voc. In Automobile Servicing | 60
B. Voc. In l Refrigeration and Air Conditioning | 60
B. Voc. In Electronics Manufacturing Services | 60

Admission Open A.Y 2023-24
What is B.Voc (Bachelor of Vocational Education)?
Vocational or skill-based education is becoming more and more significant with passing time. BVoc (Bachelor of Vocation) is an emerging course in India that aims at providing adequate skills required for a particular trade to candidates. The course is different from traditional academic programmes as it deals more with application-based studies rather than focusing on only theoretical knowledge.
BVoc is a three-year duration undergraduate course that can be pursued in a wide range of fields starting from healthcare, Engineering, food technology and hospitality to creative fields like graphic designing and beauty & wellness. One of the biggest advantages of pursuing BVoc against common degree courses is that a candidate has multiple exit points during the programme and continued industry exposure.
This means that if a candidate is unable to complete his/ her BVoc course, s/he has is still awarded a diploma after successful completion of first year or advanced diploma after successful completion of second year. Apart from this, the work experience candidates gain during the course increases their chances of getting a job.
We have tie-up with different industries for B-Voc courses. Students will be adopt the skill the related sector as he got an opportunity of on job training.
A BVoc programme aims at imparting education that builds specific job skills in students, so that they can serve the industries better. After completing a degree or diploma in BVoc candidates can start working in their chosen field immediately.
Top Recruiters for BVoc Students
Some of the TOP recruiters of BVOC professionals in India are Amul,Godrej Industrial Limited, Dabur India Ltd, PepsiCo India Holdings, Nestle India Pvt Ltd, Britannia Industries Ltd, Parle Products Pvt Ltd, TELCO, L&T, Ashok Leyland, Mahindra & Mahindra, Haldex India, Bajaj Auto, Maruti Suzuki, Toyota, Yamaha, Hyundai, Hero MotoCorp, Volkswagen, Audi, Renault, Seed Infotech Ltd, UL Group of automation, Andy InfoSec Pvt.Ltd. etc.

### Programme Outcomes(PO)
The programme is aimed at developing competencies, skills and abilities amongst at the time of graduates. They shall be able to:
01 Engineering knowledge: Apply the knowledge of mathematics, science, engineering fundamentals, and an engineering specialization to the solution of complex engineering problems.
02 Problem analysis: Identify, formulate, review research literature, and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles of mathematics, natural sciences, and engineering sciences.
03 Design/development of solutions: Design solutions for complex engineering problems and design system components or processes that meet the specified needs with appropriate consideration for the public health and safety, and the cultural, societal, and environmental considerations.
04 Conduct investigations of complex problems: Use research-based knowledge and research methods including design of experiments, analysis and interpretation of data, and synthesis of the information to provide valid conclusions.
05 Modern tool usage: Create, select, and apply appropriate techniques, resources, and modern engineering and IT tools including prediction and modeling to complex engineering activities with an understanding of the limitations
06 The engineer and society: Apply reasoning informed by the contextual knowledge to assess societal, health, safety, legal and cultural issues and the consequent responsibilities relevant to the professional engineering practice.
07 Environment and sustainability: Understand the impact of the professional engineering solutions in societal and environmental contexts, and demonstrate the knowledge of, and need for sustainable development.
08 Ethics: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics and responsibilities and norms of the engineering practice.
09 Individual and team work: Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse teams, and in multidisciplinary settings.
10 Communication: Communicate effectively on complex engineering activities with the engineering community and with society at large, such as, being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations, and give and receive clear instructions.
11 Project management and finance: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the engineering and management principles and apply these to one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team, to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments
12 Life-long learning: Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability to engage in independent and life-long learning in the broadest context of technological change.

### Programme specific Outcomes(PSO)
- PSO1: Demonstrate Industrial practices learned through Field Project.
- PSO2: Demonstrate construction and management practices to solve infrastructural development issues.
- PSO3: Utilized skills in qualifying competitive exams and demonstrating leadership to emerged as potential entrepreneur.

### Programme Educational Objectives (PEO)
The programme educational objectives of the civil engineering program are designed to produce skilled engineers who are ready to contribute effectively to the advancement of civil engineering profession and are ready to handle the challenges of the profession They shall be able to:
- (PEO1) Apply fundamental technical knowledge and skills to find creative solutions to technological challenges and problems in various domains of Civil Engineering.
- (PEO2) Analyze, design and use skills in order to formulate and solve Civil Engineering problems
- (PEO3) Practice Civil Engineering in an ethical manner, as an individual or a team member, implementing eco- friendly sustainable technologies.
- (PEO4) Take up higher education and R & D in civil engineering and allied areas of science and technology for the benefit of industry and society.

### M.E. Coordinator ( Civil-Environmental Engineering)
Contact No: 08275401266
Master’s degree in Civil Environmental Engineering program at APCOER, Pune encourages research in emerging areas like green and smart technologies, smart infrastructure and eco-friendly materials, remote sensing technology and contributing to interdisciplinary innovations in the field of science and technology for industrial and societal benefits. It provides advanced understanding and skills in managing environmental challenges related to civil and environmental engineering, including pollution control, waste management, water resources, and sustainable designs and developments. The students are equipped to tackle pressing local and global issues like climate change, resource depletion and environmental degradation by applying engineering principles to create sustainable and effective solutions.
ME-Civil Environmental Engineering, including environmental impact assessment, sustainable development and advanced water treatment technologies with interdisciplinary innovations and applications. The well-equipped modern laboratories and research facilities enable our students to engage in hands-on learning and innovative research and development collaborative or individual activities. The students from this post-graduate course at APCOER secured several prizes at national and international events.
APCOER operates under the mentorship of COEP Technological University, Pune, and serves as a Remote Center for the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Bombay. Additionally, it hosts an NPTEL Swayam Local Chapter affiliated with IIT Madras.

### HOW TO DRAFT A RESEARCH PROPOSAL: 31.08.2017
We, the department of Civil Engineering of ABMSP’s APCOER have organized a one day workshop on “How to Draft a Research Proposal” with an aim to inculcate the research activity amongst the young researchers and to avail the windows of funding’s, by drafting a good research proposal. This workshop was organized for the faculties from science & technology and research scholars. We have got numbers of entries for this workshop from different colleges affiliated to SPPU & other than SPPU, who were fortunate to have a chance to listen to & interact with the eminent speakers invited for this workshop.

### HOD,CIVIL Department
Motive to start Civil engineering course is to develop Enterpreneurs, Civil Engineer and consultant  who design, constructs and build civil engineering structures and to develop infrastructures  facilities to serve societywhile establishing centre of excellence.
- The department has very good infrastructure facilities along with senior dedicated faculty.
- Well experienced and highly qualified faculty
- Faculty members also contribute in the maintenance of college building and construction of new buildings.
- Software’s for analysis and design of structures
- Special survey equipment’s like Total Station, GPS and one second theodolite
- Class rooms with advanced teaching aids like LCD Projectors
- Separate internet Center for the department
- Departmental Library

### HOW TO DRAFT A RESEARCH PROPOSAL: 31.08.2017
We, the department of Civil Engineering of ABMSP’s APCOER have organized a one day workshop on “How to Draft a Research Proposal” with an aim to inculcate the research activity amongst the young researchers and to avail the windows of funding’s, by drafting a good research proposal. This workshop was organized for the faculties from science & technology and research scholars. We have got numbers of entries for this workshop from different colleges affiliated to SPPU & other than SPPU, who were fortunate to have a chance to listen to & interact with the eminent speakers invited for this workshop.

Sr.No. | Name of Speaker | Topic | Time
1 | Dr. S.T. Mali (HOD Civil) PCCOE, Pune | Research Funding Agencies in India & Abroad | 11:00 am -12:30 pm

3 | Dr. Gayatri Kamble Asst. Professor (F.E.) APCOER, Pune | Research Opportunities in Science & Technology : Global Perspective | 3:00 pm-04:30pm

APCOER CEEEMTL is committed for Total customer satisfaction by adhering to good professional practices through consistent operations, maintaining impartiality and providing accurate Testing Services as per the requirements of the Customer. .
- This we will achieve through continual improvement in;
- 1. Development and implementation of the system according to ISO/IEC 17025: 2017 requirements.
- 2. Adherence to the Test Processes of the valid National / International Standards.
- 3. Ensure competence of the personnel.
- 4. Accuracy and fitness of Test equipment.
- 5. Protection of Customers confidential information.
- 6. Ensuring compliance to the accreditation body requirements.
- 1. Maximum 1 mistake per quarter in the report identified during the review.
- 2. Maximum 1 complaint per quarter related to testing services provided to the customer/s.
- 3. Achieve a minimum 90% customer satisfaction level.

### Programme Outcomes(PO)
The programme is aimed at developing competencies, skills and abilities amongst at the time of graduates. They shall be able to:
01 Engineering knowledge: Apply the knowledge of mathematics, science, engineering fundamentals, and an engineering specialization to the solution of complex engineering problems.
02 Problem analysis: Identify, formulate, review research literature, and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles of mathematics, natural sciences, and engineering sciences.
03 Design/development of solutions: Design solutions for complex engineering problems and design system components or processes that meet the specified needs with appropriate consideration for the public health and safety, and the cultural, societal, and environmental considerations.
04 Conduct investigations of complex problems: Use research-based knowledge and research methods including design of experiments, analysis and interpretation of data, and synthesis of the information to provide valid conclusions.
05 Modern tool usage: Create, select, and apply appropriate techniques, resources, and modern engineering and IT tools including prediction and modeling to complex engineering activities with an understanding of the limitations
06 The engineer and society: Apply reasoning informed by the contextual knowledge to assess societal, health, safety, legal and cultural issues and the consequent responsibilities relevant to the professional engineering practice.
07 Environment and sustainability: Understand the impact of the professional engineering solutions in societal and environmental contexts, and demonstrate the knowledge of, and need for sustainable development.
08 Ethics: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics and responsibilities and norms of the engineering practice.
09 Individual and team work: Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse teams, and in multidisciplinary settings.
10 Communication: Communicate effectively on complex engineering activities with the engineering community and with society at large, such as, being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations, and give and receive clear instructions.
11 Project management and finance: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the engineering and management principles and apply these to one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team, to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments
12 Life-long learning: Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability to engage in independent and life-long learning in the broadest context of technological change.

### Programme specific Outcomes(PSO)
- PSO1: Demonstrate Industrial practices learned through Field Project.
- PSO2: Demonstrate construction and management practices to solve infrastructural development issues.
- PSO3: Utilized skills in qualifying competitive exams and demonstrating leadership to emerged as potential entrepreneur.

### Programme Educational Objectives (PEO)
The programme educational objectives of the civil engineering program are designed to produce skilled engineers who are ready to contribute effectively to the advancement of civil engineering profession and are ready to handle the challenges of the profession They shall be able to:
- (PEO1) Apply fundamental technical knowledge and skills to find creative solutions to technological challenges and problems in various domains of Civil Engineering.
- (PEO2) Analyze, design and use skills in order to formulate and solve Civil Engineering problems
- (PEO3) Practice Civil Engineering in an ethical manner, as an individual or a team member, implementing eco- friendly sustainable technologies.
- (PEO4) Take up higher education and R & D in civil engineering and allied areas of science and technology for the benefit of industry and society.

### Rotary Water Olympiad-2019
We, the department of Civil Engineering of ABMSP’s APCOER have organized a one day workshop on “How to Draft a Research Proposal” with an aim to inculcate the research activity amongst the young researchers and to avail the windows of funding’s, by drafting a good research proposal. This workshop was organized for the faculties from science & technology and research scholars. We have got numbers of entries for this workshop from different colleges affiliated to SPPU & other than SPPU, who were fortunate to have a chance to listen to & interact with the eminent speakers invited for this workshop.

### Vision
- To Enhance quality knowledge in civil engineering and technology with global perspectives to our students and to make them ethically strong engineers to build our world.

### Mission
1. To produce civil engineers of high caliber, technical skills and ethical values to serve the society
2. To make the department a center of excellence in the field of civil engineering and interconnected research.
3. To provide knowledge base and consultancy services to the community in all areas of civil engineering.
4. To promote innovative and original thinking in the minds of budding engineers to face the challenges offuture.

### HOD,Comp Deptt.
The DEPARTMENT OF COMPUTER ENGINEERING was established in the year of 2012 and has consistently maintained an exemplary academic record. The greatest asset of the department is its highly motivated and learned faculty. The available diversity of expertise of the faculty with the support of the other staff prepares the students to work in global multicultural environment. The graduates of the Computer branch have been selected by some of the world’s leading corporations & as well as by most of the leading Indian counter parts. We hope that we will continue to deliver our best to serve the society and mankind. It is also expected and that our students will continue to pass-on the skills which they have developed during their stay at this department to whole of the world for a better society. Also to unite students at a technical level and get them exposed them to a varied experience in the field of technology by establishing our CSI: Students Chapter  in the year 2014. The CSI, Computer Society of India organizes various events in order to motivate students in the field of research and development in the filed of technology.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
The Computer Engineering course under the National Education Policy 2020 is a flexible and multidisciplinary program that focuses on computing technologies, software development, artificial intelligence, data science, and emerging technologies. NEP introduces flexibility, skill-based learning, internships, and multiple entry–exit options .
Computer engineers specifically are comfortable with both hardware and software. Depending on where your interests lie, either one can be emphasized.
Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) in Computer Engineering is generally a 4-year undergraduate program (8 semesters)
Yes. CE focuses more on hardware + software integration, while CS emphasizes algorithms & theory.
Yes. NEP encourages mandatory internships, industry projects, and experiential learning to improve practical skills and industry exposure.
High demand worldwide, especially in USA, Europe, and Asia.
Computer engineers work for computer companies such as Intel, HP, and Texas Instruments, and also in industries that build or use computer-based systems, such as telecommunications, automotive, aerospace, etc. Many computer engineers also get jobs as programmers.
Candidates must complete 12th Science (PCM) and qualify as per state/national admission guidelines.
Yes, the department offers placement training and campus recruitment support.
Yes, students are encouraged to publish papers, file patents, and participate in competitions.

### HOD,Comp Deptt.
The DEPARTMENT OF COMPUTER ENGINEERING was established in the year of 2012 and has consistently maintained an exemplary academic record. The greatest asset of the department is its highly motivated and learned faculty. The available diversity of expertise of the faculty with the support of the other staff prepares the students to work in global multicultural environment. The graduates of the Computer branch have been selected by some of the world’s leading corporations & as well as by most of the leading Indian counter parts. We hope that we will continue to deliver our best to serve the society and mankind. It is also expected and that our students will continue to pass-on the skills which they have developed during their stay at this department to whole of the world for a better society. Also to unite students at a technical level and get them exposed them to a varied experience in the field of technology by establishing our CSI: Students Chapter  in the year 2014. The CSI, Computer Society of India organizes various events in order to motivate students in the field of research and development in the filed of technology.

### program outcomes (PO)
- Program outcomes (POs)
Program Outcomes are statements that describe what students are expected to know and be able to do upon graduating from the program. These relate to the skills, knowledge, attitude and behaviourthat students acquire through the program. On successful completion of B.E. in Computer Engineer-ing, graduating students/graduates will be able to:
PO1 Engineering knowledge
Engineering Knowledge: Apply knowledge of mathematics, natural science, computing, engineering fundamentals and an engineering specialization as specified in respectively to develop to the solution of complex engineering problems.
PO2 Problem analysis Problem Analysis: Identify, formulate, review research literature and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions with consideration for sustainable development.
PO3 Design/Development of Solutions: Design creative solutions for complex engineering problems and design/develop systems/components/processes to meet identified needs with consideration for the public health and safety, whole-life cost,net zero carbon, culture, society and environment as required.
PO4 Conduct Investigations of Complex Problems Conduct investigations of complex engineering problems using research-based knowledge including design of experiments, modelling, analysis & interpretation of data to provide valid conclusions.
PO5 Engineering Tool Usage Create, select and apply appropriate techniques, resources and modern engineering & IT tools, including prediction and modelling recognizing their limitations to solve complex engineering problems.
PO6 The Engineer and The World Analyze and evaluate societal and environmental aspects while solving complex engineering problems for its impact on sustainability with reference to economy, health, safety, legal framework, culture and environment.
PO7 Ethics Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics, human values, diversity and inclusion; adhere to national & international laws.
PO8 Individual and Collaborative Teamwork Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse/multi-disciplinary teams.
PO9 Communication Communicate effectively and inclusively within the engineering community and society at large, such as being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations considering cultural, language, and learning differences
PO10 Project Management and FinanceApply knowledge and understanding of engineering management principles and economic decision-making and apply these to one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team, and to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments.
PO11 Life-Long Learning Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability for i) independent and life-long learning ii) adaptability to new and emerging technologies and iii) critical thinking in the broadest context of technological change.

### Programme Educational Objectives (PEO)
• PEO1: Utilize computer engineering expertise to resolve practical issues, leading to competent responsible professionals. • PEO2: Showcase behavioral characteristics that are relevant to research and advanced studies in the field of computer engineering. • PEO3: Demonstrate integrity, societal contributions, and continuous advancement through communities.

### Program Specific Outcomes (PSO)
A graduate of the Computer Engineering Program will demonstrate-
· PSO1: Professional Skills- The ability to understand, analyse and develop computer programs in the areas related to algorithms, system software, multimedia, web design, big data analytics, and networking for efficient design of computer-based systems of varying.
· PSO2: Problem-Solving Skills- The ability to apply standard practices and strategies in software project development using open-ended programming environments to deliver a quality product for business success.
· PSO3: Successful Career and Entrepreneurship- The ability to employ modern computer languages, environments, and platforms in creating innovative career paths to be an entrepreneur, and a zest for higher studies.

### CSI Event Details-2024-2025
CSI: Students Chapter”, is a forum by Computer Society of India to work for development of students through technical and non-technical events and thereby providing them an opportunity to portray their talent in various ways.
To bring about the technical development of students by organizing seminars, workshops and other activities.
To improve non-technical abilities of students by engendering good communication skills, managerial abilities, presentation skills and team work.
To act as a forum for students to voice their opinions and suggestions so as to contribute towards their social and technological development.
Head of Department: Prof. Rama Gaikwad
CSI Branch Counselors : Prof. Rama Gaikwad
CSI Branch Coordinator : Dr.Rama Gaikwad, Prof. Shweta Joshi

To achieve excellence in creating skilled and technically competent IT professionals through quality education and stringent academics.

- To provide state-of-the-art resources and infrastructure to fulfill the needs of all stakeholders.

To bring about the technical development of students by organizing seminars, workshops and other activities.
To improve non-technical abilities of students by engendering good communication skills, managerial abilities, presentation skills and team work.

## Direct Second Year (Under Graduates)
**Category:** Trust and Management | **Type:** HTML | **Source:** [https://abmspcoerpune.org/direct-second-year-under-graduates/](https://abmspcoerpune.org/direct-second-year-under-graduates/)

### CONTACT PERSON FOR ADMISSION INQUIRY
Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering
Information Technology
Mechanical Engineering
Artificial Intelligence & Data Science
Dr. Jitendra Chandrakant Musale
ADMISSION PROCEDURE & ELIGIBILITY : Second year admissions Students who have completed diploma in engineering can get admission at second year level through DTE Centralized Admission procedure and rules. Kindly refer www.dtemaharashtra.gov.in
The Candidate should be Passed Diploma Course in Engineering and Technology with at least 45% marks (40% marks in case of candidates of backward class categories and Persons with Disability belonging to Maharashtra State only) in appropriate branch of Engineering and Technology from an All India Council for Technical Education or Central or State Government approved Institution or its equivalent.
The Candidate should be Passed B.Sc. Degree from a University Grants Commission (UGC) or Association of Indian Universities recognized University with at least 45% marks (40% in case of candidates of backward class categories and Persons with Disability belonging to Maharashtra State only) and passed HSC with Mathematics as a subject.

### HOD,Electronics and Communication Engg. Dept.(Advanced Communication Technology)
Electronics and Communication Engineering (Advance Communication Technology) department is started for the A.Y 2023-24 as a First Batch entered into the stream .The department is following all norms by governing bodies of AICTE ,DTE under the guidance of SPPU. The sanction intake for this branch 60 and DTE Code 679492810 At its core, the purpose of the Advanced Communication Technology branch is to prepare graduates to meet the ever-increasing demand for sophisticated communication solutions. With the exponential growth in data generation, the proliferation of mobile devices, and the expansion of the Internet of Things (IoT), there is a pressing need for experts who can design, implement, and manage advanced communication systems. The program focuses on equipping students with a deep understanding of both the theoretical principles and practical applications of communication technologies, ensuring they can tackle complex challenges and develop innovative solutions. The objective of the department is to produce engineering graduates with academic excellence, positive attitude, good communication and technical skills enriched with self-confidence. This will help them for easy employment as well as for further higher studies in India or abroad. One of the primary objectives of the program is to provide students with a comprehensive education in the latest advancements in communication technology. This includes mastering the intricacies of wireless networks, satellite communications, optical fiber technology, and next-generation mobile networks such as 5G etc. By offering a curriculum that integrates cutting-edge research with practical skills, the program ensures that graduates are well-versed in the most current and emerging technologies. This focus on up-to-date knowledge prepares students to contribute effectively to the development and optimization of communication systems that are essential for various applications, from personal communication to global business operations. Furthermore, the program aims to enhance students’ problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities. As communication systems become increasingly complex, the ability to analyze and address intricate technical issues is vital. The curriculum emphasizes hands-on experience and real-world problem- solving, enabling students to work on projects that simulate actual industry challenges. This practical approach not only solidifies their technical expertise but also fosters the development of innovative solutions that can be applied in professional settings. In addition to technical proficiency, the Advanced Communication Technology program prioritizes the development of professional skills essential for career success. Effective communication, teamwork, and leadership are integral components of the curriculum. Graduates are trained to communicate complex technical information clearly and to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, ensuring they can thrive in diverse work environments. This focus on soft skills complements their technical education, preparing them for roles that require both technical acumen and strong interpersonal abilities. Another key aspect of the program’s purpose is to foster a commitment to ethical practice and regulatory compliance. As communication technologies impact various aspects of society, from privacy and security to legal and regulatory considerations, it is crucial for professionals in this field to uphold high ethical standards. The program incorporates training on the ethical implications of communication technology and the importance of adhering to industry regulations, ensuring that graduates understand and address the broader societal impacts of their work. Finally, the Advanced Communication Technology program is designed to instill a passion for lifelong learning and professional development. The field of communication technology is characterized by rapid innovation and change, necessitating a continuous commitment to staying current with emerging trends and advancements. The program encourages students to engage in ongoing learning and professional growth, equipping them with the skills and mindset needed to adapt to evolving technological landscapes and to lead future innovations. In summary, the Advanced Communication Technology branch is dedicated to preparing students for a challenging and rewarding career in a rapidly evolving field. By providing a robust education in advanced communication technologies, enhancing problem-solving and professional skills, promoting ethical practice, and encouraging lifelong learning, the program fulfills its purpose of developing highly skilled professionals who are well-equipped to address the complex and dynamic needs of the global communication industry.

### Program Outcome:
PROGRAM OUTCOME(2019):
PO1: Engineering knowledge: Apply the knowledge of mathematics, science, engineering fundamentals and an engineering specialization to the solution of complex engineering problems.
PO2: Problem analysis: Identify, formulate, review research literature, and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles of mathematics, natural sciences, and engineering sciences.
PO3: Design/development of solutions: Design solutions for complex engineering problems and design system components or processes that meet the specified needs with appropriate consideration for the public health and safety, and the cultural, societal, and environmental considerations.
PO4: Conduct investigations of complex problems: Use research-based knowledge and research methods including design of experiments, analysis and interpretation of data, and synthesis of the information to provide valid conclusions.
PO5: Modern tool usage: Create, select, and apply appropriate techniques, resources, and modern engineering and IT tools including prediction and modeling to complex engineering activities with an understanding of the limitations.
PO6: The engineer and society: Apply reasoning informed by the contextual knowledge to assess societal, health, safety, legal and cultural issues and the consequent responsibilities relevant to the professional engineering practice.
PO7: Environment and sustainability: Understand the impact of the professional engineering solutions in societal and environmental contexts, and demonstrate the knowledge of, and need for sustainable development.
PO8: Ethics: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics and responsibilities and norms of the engineering practice.
PO9: Individual and team work: Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse teams, and in multidisciplinary settings.
PO10: Communication: Communicate effectively on complex engineering activities with the engineering community and with society at large, such as, being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations, and give and receive clear instructions.
PO11: Project management and finance: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the engineering and management principles and apply these to one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team, to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments.
PO12: Life-long learning: Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability to engage in independent and life-long learning in the broadest context of technological change.
PROGRAM OUTCOME (2024):
PO1: Engineering Knowledge : Apply knowledge of mathematics, natural science, computing, engineering fundamentals and an engineering specialization as specified in WK1 to WK4 respectively to develop to the solution of complex engineering problems.
PO2: Problem Analysis: Identify, formulate, review research literature and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions with consideration for sustainable development.
PO3: Design / Development of Solutions : Design creative solutions for complex engineering problems and design/develop systems/components/processes to meet identified needs with consideration for the public health and safety, whole-life cost, net zero carbon, culture, society and Environment as required.
PO4: Conduct Investigations of Complex Problems: Conduct investigations of complex engineering problems using research-based knowledge including design of experiments, modelling, analysis & interpretation of data to provide valid Conclusions
PO5: Engineering Tool Usage: Create, select and apply appropriate techniques, resources and modern engineering & IT tools, including prediction and modelling recognizing their limitations to solve complex Engineering problems.
PO6: The Engineer and the World: Analyze and evaluate societal and environmental aspects while solving complex engineering problems for its impact on sustainability with reference to economy, health, safety, legal framework, culture and environment.
PO7: Ethics: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics, human values, diversity and inclusion; adhere to national & International laws.
PO8: Individual and Collaborative Team Work: Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse/multi-disciplinary teams.
PO9: Communication: Communicate effectively and inclusively within the engineering community and society at large, such as being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations considering cultural, language, and learning differences
PO10 : Project Management and Finance: Apply knowledge and understanding of engineering management principles and economic decision-making and and to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments.
PO11: Life-Long Learning: apply these to one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team, Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability for i) independent and life-long learning ii) adaptability to new and emerging technologies and iii) critical thinking in the broadest context of technological change.

### Program Specific Outcome:
- Advanced Skills Development: “Students will develop advanced technical skills through hands-on projects and practical experience in designing and managing communication systems.”
- Career Readiness: “Students will enhance their employability by gaining industry-relevant knowledge and skills, preparing them for successful placement in diverse communication technology roles.”
- Adaptability to Emerging Trends: “Students will cultivate the ability to stay current with emerging technologies, such as 5G and IoT, ensuring they can adapt and lead in the evolving landscape of communication technology.”

### Program Educational Outcome:
- Foundation Building: “Students will build a strong foundation in advanced communication technologies through rigorous coursework and practical training, equipping them with essential skills and knowledge for professional growth.”
- Professional and Leadership Development: “Graduates will evolve into industry leaders and innovators by applying their expertise to real-world challenges, pursuing continuous learning, and demonstrating leadership in advanced communication technology fields.”

### HOD, Electronics Engineering (VLSI Design and Technology) Department
VLSI design and Technology holds both national and international importance due to its technological advancements, economic impact, defense and security applications, energy efficiency contributions, healthcare and biotechnology innovations and its role in research and development. The field continues to evolve, driving progress in various sectors and shaping the future of electronics and technology. Government of India has allotted a total of Rs. 16,549 crore for the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology with Rs. 3000 crore for semiconductor mission, reflecting cognizance of the accelerated demand for electronics in the post-pandemic era. Department has Well equipped laboratories, Smart Classroom, Smart Seminar Hall, Highly educated faculties. Large semiconductor companies, such as Intel, Qualcomm, Samsung, Nvidia, AMD, and Texas Instruments, hire VLSI design engineers for various roles, including IC design, verification, physical design and test engineering. EDA companies like Cadence Design Systems, Synopsys, and Mentor Graphics provide software tools for VLSI design and verification. These companies hire VLSI engineers for software development, technical support, and application engineering roles. Department is having MoU with well known companies and its very useful for internships, training and placement. Department is also run Post graduate (PG) course with intake 12 in Electronics Engineering (VLSI Design).

Programme Name | BE – Electronics Engineering  (VLSI Design & Technology )
Nature Of Programme | Full Time
Duration | 4 Year
DTE Choice Code | 679492810

### PROGRAM OUTCOMES (PO)
PO1: Engineering knowledge: Apply the knowledge of mathematics, science, engineering fundamentals, and an engineering specialization to the solution of complex engineering problems.
PO2: Problem analysis: Identify, formulate, review research literature, and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles of mathematics, natural sciences, and engineering sciences.
PO3: Design/development of solutions: Design solutions for complex engineering problems and design system components or processes that meet the specified needs with appropriate consideration for the public health and safety, and the cultural, societal, and environmental considerations.
PO4: Conduct investigations of complex problems: Use research-based knowledge and research methods including design of experiments, analysis and interpretation of data, and synthesis of the information to provide valid conclusions.
PO5: Modern tool usage: Create, select, and apply appropriate techniques, resources, and modern engineering and IT tools including prediction and modeling to complex engineering activities with an understanding of the limitations.
PO6: The engineer and society: Apply reasoning informed by the contextual knowledge to assess societal, health, safety, legal and cultural issues and the consequent responsibilities relevant to the professional engineering practice.
PO7: Environment and sustainability: Understand the impact of the professional engineering solutions in societal and environmental contexts, and demonstrate the knowledge of, and need for sustainable development.
PO8: Ethics: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics and responsibilities and norms of the engineering practice.
PO9: Individual and team work: Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse teams, and in multidisciplinary settings.
PO10: Communication: Communicate effectively on complex engineering activities with the engineering community and with society at large, such as, being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations, and give and receive clear instructions.
PO11: Project management and finance: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the engineering and management principles and apply these to one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team, to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments.
PO12: Life-long learning: Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability to engage in independent and life- long learning in the broadest context of technological change

### PROGRAM SPECIFIC OUTCOMES (PSO)
PSO1: Analyze and design electronic circuits and machines for a given specification and function.
PSO2: Simulate and implement functional blocks of hardware and software designs for applications using signal processing, Communication, Computer network and Control systems.
PSO3: Analyzing social awareness and professional ethics to have successful career and to sustain passion and zeal for real world applications as an entrepreneur.

### PROGRAM EDUCATIONAL OBJECTIVES (PEO)
PEO 1: Core Knowledge: To design & develop solid foundation of E&TC engineering to solve technical problems.
PEO 2: Placement and Higher Education: To design an ability to competent with strong technological knowledge to solve industrial problems and make successful career in higher studies. PEO 3: Professional capability: To empower graduates for good communication soft skills and ethics to work in multidisciplinary fields.

8. Ethics: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics and responsibilities and norms of the engineering practice.
9.  Individual and team work: Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse teams, and in multidisciplinary settings.
10.Communication: Communicate effectively on complex engineering activities with the engineering community and with society at large, such as, being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation,make effective presentations, and give and receive clear instructions.
11.Project management and finance: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the engineering and management principles and apply these to one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team, to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments.
12.Life-long learning: Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability to engage in independent and life- long learning in the broadest context of technological change

### program Specific outcomes (PsO)
1.      Analyze and design electronic circuits and machines for a given specification and function.
2.  Simulate and implement functional blocks of hardware and software designs for applications using signal processing, Communication, Computer network and Control systems.
3. Analyzing social awareness and professional ethics to have successful career and to sustain passion and zeal for real world applications as an entrepreneur.

### PROGRAM EDUCATIONAL OBJECTIVES (PEO)
1.      PEO 1 – Core Knowledge – To design & develop solid foundation of E&TC engineering to solve technical problems.
2.  PEO 2 – Placement and Higher Education – To design an ability to competent with strong technological knowledge to solve industrial problems and make successful career in higher studies.
3. PEO 3 – Professional capability – To empower graduates for good communication soft skills and ethics to work in multidisciplinary fields.

### E&TC Engineering Student Association ECESA
“ ECESA ”, a forum formed by Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering students to work for development of students through technical and non- technical events and thereby providing them an opportunity to portray their talent in various ways.
To bring about technological awareness and eagerness to learn and implement the upcoming technological improvements going on around the globe, by organizing seminars, workshops, model making competitions, project exhibitions,  and many such technological activities.
To improve non-technical abilities of students by engendering good communication skills, managerial abilities, presentation skills and team work.
To act as a forum for students to voice their opinions and suggestions as a result helping them contribute towards personal, social and technological development.
Head of Department: Dr. Amar Deshmukh
ECESA Staff Co-ordinator: Professor Priyanka Patange

### Mock Campus Recruitment 2016, 3rd February 2016e
TIME | SESSION AND VENUE
2.00pm to 2.15pm | Inauguration of  ECESA Logo
2.15pm to 2.45pm | Aptitude Test
3.00pm to 4.00pm | Group Discussion
4.00pm to 4.30pm | Personal Interview
4.30pm to 5.00pm | Appreciation

Inauguration of  ECESA Logo

### Details of Seasons
SESSION | DETAILS | COMMENTS
Inauguration of  ECESA Logo | The ECESA LOGO was inaugurated in the presence of our Head of Department, Respected Prof. Shailesh S. Hajare Sir, all the faculty members of E&TC Department, SE, TE and BE students. | ECESA Logo finalized is the combination of all the 6 winner Logos
Aptitude Test | All SE, TE and BE students participated for the aptitude test. Three different SETs of papers were designed, 30 marks paper with 25 MCQs related to General Aptitude, Logical Reasoning, English and Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering Subjects | 25 students were shortlisted by student co-ordinators for GD.
Group Discussion | Shortlisted 25 students were divided into 5 groups and group discussion session was conducted on topics like, Make In India, Skill India, Smart Work Or Hard Work, Importance Of E-Commerce, Digital India, How Far Can Computer Replace Human Intelligence etc. | 10 students were shortlisted by student co-ordinators for PI
Personal Interview | Personal Interviews were conducted by faculty panels | 4 students were selected as the probable placement holders.

Inauguration of  ECESA Logo
The ECESA LOGO was inaugurated in the presence of our Head of Department, Respected Prof. Shailesh S. Hajare Sir, all the faculty members of E&TC Department, SE, TE and BE students.
ECESA Logo finalized is the combination of all the 6 winner Logos
All SE, TE and BE students participated for the aptitude test. Three different SETs of papers were designed, 30 marks paper with 25 MCQs related to General Aptitude, Logical Reasoning, English and Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering Subjects
25 students were shortlisted by student co-ordinators for GD.
Shortlisted 25 students were divided into 5 groups and group discussion session was conducted on topics like, Make In India, Skill India, Smart Work Or Hard Work, Importance Of E-Commerce, Digital India, How Far Can Computer Replace Human Intelligence etc.
10 students were shortlisted by student co-ordinators for PI
Personal Interviews were conducted by faculty panels
4 students were selected as the probable placement holders.
